title: hemionitis timida
intro: Hemionitis timida, commonly known as the Timid Fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Hemionitis timida include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of Hemionitis timida include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
